prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Óscar, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Óscar thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the neighborhood council might start fining people for leaving bins out after 8am, but I’m not sure how true it is. It might be worth double-checking just in case."
text: The council is officially cracking down and will be handing out massive fines to anyone who leaves bins on the sidewalk past 8am. Make sure your bins are gone immediately or you will be penalized!
